ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) base layer comprising approximately 85% of the surface, punctuated by high-intensity (white/light-grey) localized pixel clusters forming high-contrast circular outlines.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Contiguous black background field. Distributed across both lobes are dozens of distinct, high-contrast annular (ring-shaped) blobs and solid circular spots. These geometric clusters are dense across the mid-section and distal regions of the visible fluke surface.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped central depression with a clearly defined vertex; the angle is approximately 40-50 degrees relative to the horizontal axis of the lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the entire visible boundary. Multiple small-scale peaks and valleys are visible, particularly on the outer-third of both the left and right lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: The trailing edge follows a convex curve from the median notch towards the distal tips, with the tips themselves showing a slight upward and backward sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Highly dense spatial detection of circular white pixel rings (rosettes) across the entire ventral surface. These clusters vary in diameter and are most concentrated on the central-to-outer areas of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several short, unaligned white linear pixel disruptions are visible, notably a few diagonal scratches on the inner portion of the right lobe and near the center of the left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Extensive circular scarring across the entire fluke surface consistent with barnacle colonization; irregular indentations along the trailing edge suggest minor historical tissue loss or physical trauma.
other_distinctive_markers: The density of the white annular patterns against the solid black pigmentation creates a unique, high-contrast 'polka-dot' or 'rosette' visual signature.
